facts.value: Microsoft Project is a project management app developed by Microsoft and included in the Office suite. Designed to help you plan, execute and monitor every stage of your work, Microsoft Project allows you to organize all parts of your project without losing sight of deadlines, resources and associated costs, whether for individual or team projects.

An Excel-like interface, Create visual and dynamic timelines, In-depth management of resources, costs and assignments, Monitor progress in real-time, Collaborate with your team in a centralized environment, Adapt to any type of project, regardless of its size.
